title: Measure the right work, not more work
dek: Tokens, commits and lines tell you how much happened. They don't tell you whether it was right. Two paired numbers do better.

sections.title: Busy is not the same as right
body: Activity counters only go up. They rise on good weeks and bad ones alike.
sections.caption: Counters that only go up.

sections.title: Volume is a vanity metric
body: More commits, more tokens, more lines: all of these go up when work is going badly too, because fixing things is also activity.

sections.title: First-turn resolution and rework share
body: First-turn resolution is the share of sessions completed without a correction. Rework share is the share of effort that came from corrected sessions. Read them together: high resolution with rising rework means work is being deferred, not done.
points: Never read a speed metric alone
Treat rising rework as an early warning

sections.title: Grouped by what they answer
body: Group metrics by the question they answer (outcome, quality, velocity, usage, cost) and always show a velocity number next to its quality companion.

takeaway: Measure the right work, not more work.
takeawaySub: Pair every speed metric with its quality companion.
